Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Kunal - 8 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Shalini - 38 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Vikram - 43 years, father
Look: light beard, green T-shirt

Places

1. The snowy hillside - white snow, deodar trees
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The snowy hillside - Day

[Kunal stands in the snow. Shalini and Vikram stand near him.]

Shalini: "What lovely weather!"

[Snow starts to fall.]

Kunal: "Mom, look at this."

[Kunal makes a snowball and throws it at Mother.]

Kunal: "And then?"

[Kunal builds a snowman.]

Kunal: "Hey, look at that!"

[Kunal catches snowflakes in his hands.]

Shalini (happily): "Kunal, are you okay?"

[Kunal slides down the snowy slope.]

Kunal: "Mom, are you okay?"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Kunal stands in the living room. Shalini stands near him.]

Kunal: "What a nice place."

[Kunal eats his breakfast at the table.]

Kunal: "This is amazing!"

[Kunal takes a bite of his sandwich.]

Shalini: "Kunal, listen!"

[Kunal sips hot tea from a cup.]

Kunal: "What next?"

[Kunal serves hot rotis to Mother.]

Kunal (gently): "How beautiful!"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[Kunal stands in the courtyard. Shalini and Vikram stand near him.]

Kunal: "Let's begin."

[Kunal sings a song.]

Kunal: "Yes, of course."

[Kunal shakes his head.]

Kunal: "Really?"

[Kunal scratches his head.]

Shalini: "Show me too!"

[Kunal shouts angrily.]

Kunal: "Slowly, take it easy."

Scene 4: The courtyard - Day

[Kunal stands in the courtyard. Shalini and Vikram stand near him.]

Vikram: "Let's begin."

[Kunal feeds the dog.]

Kunal: "What happened?"

[Kunal milks the cow.]

Kunal: "Slowly, take it easy."

[A cat walks along the wall.]

Vikram (surprised): "Okay, Shalini."

[Kunal pats his horse.]

Vikram (laughing): "That was such a fun day!"
